entities.summary: Archbishop Averky was a bishop of the Russian Orthodox Church Outside of Russia, Archbishop of Syracuse and Holy Trinity, rector of Holy Trinity Monastery and rector of Holy Trinity Orthodox Seminary in Jordanville, New York. A notable Russian Orthodox theologian and spiritual writer of the 20th century, publicist.
